targets.notes: KNOWN ONE-LEG LIMITATION (same class as depreciation.json's): 30 of 77 lines have BOTH a positive Quantity_Accepted and a positive Quantity_Rejected, which SAP models as TWO MSEG movements -- 101 (GR into stock) for the accepted quantity and 122 (return/reversal) for the rejected. The engine has no conditional row-splitting transform, so this spec emits only the 101 leg with Quantity_Accepted; rejected quantities are NOT emitted and must not be assumed zero. The rejected 122 leg needs either a row-expansion engine capability or a pre-split source extract -- flagged, not worked around. BWART='101' is the standard delivered movement type for GR against PO. Lot_Number_ID is 91% null in the source and batch (MCHA/MCH1) handling is not decided, so it is dropped with a reason rather than half-mapped.

superseded by Quantity_Accepted -- the legacy column counts delivered goods, MSEG must carry what actually entered stock; the delta (rejected) needs a 122 movement this spec cannot emit (see notes)

valuation comes from the PO price via the account assignment, not a flat MSEG field
pricing condition data, not a goods-movement field

tax condition result, not a goods-movement field
